topic_title: Move Over / Slow Down Act — Passing Stopped Service Vehicles
prompt: Under TTC §545.157, what is the speed requirement when passing an emergency vehicle on a road with a speed limit under 25 mph?

options.text: Slow down to a speed of fifteen miles per hour below the posted limit
Slow down to a speed of five miles per hour below the posted limit
Maintain the posted speed limit because speed is already low enough
Come to a complete stop and wait for officer hand signaling to pass
